rules.statement: A person who enters into occupation of property as a licensee cannot acquire prescriptive right to the property unless they produce an event or overt act that manifests their intention to occupy the property as the owner.
rules.supporting_quote: A person, who is let into occupation of property as a tenant, or as a licensee, must be deemed to continue to occupy on the footing on which he was admitted, until by some overt act by which he manifests his intention of occupying it in another capacity.
